scope: The installer uses KWin's registered Rounded Corners setting, rechecks delayed activation and records effect-specific diagnostics when activation is unconfirmed.

checks.command: In an isolated user environment and private D-Bus session, python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_rounded_corners_step.py tests/test_kconf_update.py tests/test_theme_switch.py. 176 passed and the opt-in standalone native build was skipped.

Install Golden Gate on a disposable KDE neon 6.8.1 Wayland guest. With the effect loaded, notify the legacy short setting false, then the registered setting false, then the short setting true. Observe D-Bus loadedEffects after each write. Reinstall, verify the registered setting and the loaded plugin.
observed: Legacy false left the effect loaded

coverage_limits: No native code or shaders changed. The original 6.8.3 log does not contain KWin loader output. The reproducible setting mismatch and delayed-query regression do not identify the historical machine's loader state. No separate X11 or Tahoe desktop was exercised.
